entities.name: Uuserk Marshes
entities.description: An inhospitable region of swamps and quagmires in Zhalfir, home to the tomb-city of Aku.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The plane of which the Uuserk Marshes now form a part.

entities.name: Aku
entities.description: A tomb-city built in the Uuserk Marshes, far from civilization to discourage grave-robbers.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: A war during which the trails to the marshes were closed.

entities.name: Ekemet
entities.description: A Femeref scout who died with her troupe in the swamp.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A foe defeated in a final magical duel in the swamp.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased out northwestern Jamuraa to spare it the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: An invasion of Dominaria that Teferi wished to spare northwestern Jamuraa from.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: A later Phyrexian invasion, after which the marshes were returned to the multiverse.

events.summary: The Femeref scout Ekemet and her troupe mysteriously die in the swamp, and the trails to the marshes are closed.
events.quote: when the Femeref scout Ekemet and her troupe mysteriously died in the swamp

events.summary: Kaervek is defeated in a final magical duel in the swamp.

events.summary: Teferi phases out northwestern Jamuraa, including the Uuserk, to spare it the Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: Jeska destroys the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void, leaving the marshes thought lost.
events.quote: when Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void

events.summary: The marshes return to the multiverse as part of Zhalfir after the New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch.
events.quote: They now exist as part of the plane of Zhalfir.
